verdict: Leads surged at record-low cost, but none are reaching your pipeline yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 91 leads at a cost of $19.84 per lead — the most efficient result in your recorded history, driven by the August Re-Launch campaign on Meta. Week over week, leads jumped 61% while cost per lead fell 28%, so the ad side of the funnel is performing well. The problem is downstream: your CRM shows 74 contacts and zero opportunities created, meaning leads are arriving but not converting into active cases. Automated follow-up tools that would address this are being brought online by end of month, which should close that gap. Expect the pipeline picture to sharpen materially once those are live.

cost per lead this period, down 28% week over week and the best on record

watch_item.issue: Leads are entering the CRM but zero are advancing to pipeline — intake is the gap, not the ads.
watch_item.fix: Automated SMS follow-up and voice access are being deployed by September 30 to ensure every inbound lead is contacted and logged immediately.
